1444.name: Ender Pumpkin
1444.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Ender Pumpkins never need to worry about going hungry. As long as one of their companions gets enough to eat, none of them feel hungry. Their only dietary concern is whether some mischievous companion has drunk expired milk.</color>
1444.info:
Uses the plant inside its shell as a sample, retrieves matching cards from Ender Space, and distributes them automatically.

<color=#3D1400>Toughness: </color><color=red>4000</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Every second, checks the plant in the Main position on its tile, retrieves the matching card from Ender Space, and plants it in another Ender Pumpkin whose Main position is empty.</color>

1445.name: Super Gatling Fume-shroom
1445.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Super Gatling Fume-shroom has always had one problem. He wants to lower his helmet visor and look cool, but even the largest helmet cannot line the visor up with his eyes.</color>
1445.info:
Fires peas and a full-lane cloud of fumes. The fumes build momentum in straight-flying projectiles.

<color=#3D1400>Usage Conditions: </color><color=red>Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>20 + (20 x 6) / 1.5s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Attacks the entire lane ahead.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>While attacking, accelerates straight-flying projectiles moving right in front of it and increases their damage by 1% every 0.02s.</color>
<color=#3D1400>3. </color><color=red>Each projectile from a normal attack has a 2% chance to trigger its Ultimate: restores HP equal to its Toughness, becomes immune to damage and crushing for 1 second, quadruples the damage bonus it provides, and scatters 3 peas every 0.02s.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Super Gatling Pea + Fume-shroom</color>

1446.name: Marigold-shroom
1446.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Marigold-shroom is an excellent listener. She enjoys conversation, gossip, stories, and generally hearing what others have to say. You can read all about her love of listening in her book, A Penny for Your Thoughts. It is currently available only as an audiobook.</color>
1446.info:
Produces a small amount of money, then produces more after growing up.

<color=#3D1400>Money Production: </color><color=red>100 (300) / 25s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Traits: </color><color=red>Short, Stackable</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Produces 100 money each time. Grows up after 120 seconds, increasing each production to 300 money.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Puff-shroom (base) + Marigold</color>

1447.name: Giant Marigold-shroom
1447.introduce: <color=#3D1400>For a banker, Giant Marigold-shroom has no grand ambitions. Most days, all he thinks about is ordering a hot cup of coffee ground from golden Coffee Beans after work. Nothing more.</color>
1447.info:
A forward-thinking money producer that invests stored golden Coffee Beans and withdraws them in batches when producing.

<color=#3D1400>Money Production: </color><color=red>900 / 50s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>When producing money, withdraws as many groups of 1000 as possible from its savings, stopping once the stored amount falls below 50% of the amount present when withdrawal began.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Ultimate: </color><color=red>Spends 1000 money and stores 1250 money.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Fume-shroom + Marigold</color>

1448.name: Sniper Scaredy-shroom
1448.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Sniper Scaredy-shroom is not actually timid, but he always acts frightened and helpless when zombies get close. "Do not tell anyone," he whispers. For a sniper, admitting that his close-range vision is poor and forces him to aim again would be far more embarrassing than simply claiming to be scared.</color>
1448.info:
A sniper who raises his attack speed to an extreme.

<color=#3D1400>Usage Conditions: </color><color=red>Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>500 / 3s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Uses the same targeting range, attack range, and attack pattern as Snipea.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>After each attack, reduces its attack interval by 0.1 seconds, down to a minimum of 0.5 seconds. This bonus resets when it becomes scared.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Snipea + Scaredy-shroom</color>

1449.name: Silver Hypno-shroom
1449.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Silver Hypno-shroom is eloquent, knowledgeable, and dazzling, nearly perfect in every way. Unfortunately, she lacks Hypno-shroom's vivid colors, so she cannot stand any remark about looking pale. Eventually, that grew into a dislike of every word that might suggest shock, whitening, plainness, darkness, or fading.</color>
1449.info:
Drops silver coins after hypnotizing a zombie.

<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Drops 100 money after hypnotizing the zombie that bites it.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>Spend 1000 money to upgrade it into Gold Hypno-shroom.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Hypno-shroom + Marigold</color>

1450.name: Gold Hypno-shroom
1450.introduce: <color=#3D1400>How could zombies who desire nothing but brains be bribed with money? Is money really all Gold Hypno-shroom gives them? The plants trade theories, but Gold Hypno-shroom dismisses them all. It seems only she knows the truth.</color>
1450.info:
Its Ultimate hires an enemy of a matching type based on the opposing lineup.

<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Drops 300 money after hypnotizing the zombie that bites it.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>When upgraded from Silver Hypno-shroom, uses its Ultimate once for free.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Ultimate: </color><color=red>Costs 1000 money and has a 2-second cooldown. Randomly summons one hypnotized zombie from the current wave's spawn list, excluding flying, Ultimate, and Boss zombies. If there is no valid target, summons a hypnotized Buckethead Zombie instead.</color>

1451.name: Cherry Puff-shroom
1451.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Cherry Puff-shrooms are mischievous and cheerful. They love parties and games, and whenever someone has a birthday, they leap onto the cake to surprise the guest of honor. They are confident that their flavor and crunch are far better than the cherries that were originally on top.</color>
1451.info:
Attaches a Half-Ripe Cherry when it bursts, causing a stronger explosion after a delay.

<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>900</color>
<color=#3D1400>Traits: </color><color=red>Short, Stackable</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>When it touches a non-flying zombie or dies, attaches a Half-Ripe Cherry to one random zombie within 1.5 tiles. The cherry's base damage equals this plant's Attack Power. It then deals Cherry Bomb damage in a 1.5-tile radius, with the same effect as Explosive Cherry.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Puff-shroom (base) + Cherry Bomb</color>

1452.name: Chomper Scaredy-shroom
1452.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Chomper Scaredy-shroom takes oral hygiene very seriously because she fears being trapped with her own bad breath whenever she hides. She still cannot decide whether cleaning her head calls for shampoo or mouthwash.</color>
1452.info:
Swallows nearby zombies when frightened, then spits out corpse chunks to attack once the threat is gone.

<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>40 / 1.5s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>When frightened, devours up to 3 zombies in a 3 x 3 area. This effect then enters a 40-second cooldown, during which it fires ground-rolling corpse chunks with unlimited piercing.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Scaredy-shroom + Chomper</color>

1453.name: Umbrella Fume-shroom
1453.introduce: <color=#3D1400>"This is the trendiest hairstyle around. It makes me look handsome and dependable, and it keeps out dust, basketballs, and zombies falling from the sky," Umbrella Fume-shroom says, praising his new style without restraint. His friends know the real reason he likes it so much: it hides his crooked nozzle.</color>
1453.info:
Absorbs the pressure of zombie attacks and uses it to strengthen its fumes.

<color=#3D1400>Toughness: </color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>40 / 1.5s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Fumes deal bonus damage equal to its stored Energy, then clear all Energy.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>When hit by anything other than umbrella knockback, gains Energy equal to 50% of the incoming damage, capped at its Toughness, then reduces that hit's damage by 90%.</color>
<color=#3D1400>3. </color><color=red>After deflecting a projectile, gains Energy equal to the projectile's damage.</color>
<color=#3D1400>4. Umbrella Knockback: </color><color=red>Deals damage once equal to its Attack Power and gains the same amount of Energy once for each zombie knocked back.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Fume-shroom + Umbrella Leaf</color>

1454.name: Doom Flower Pot
1454.introduce: <color=#3D1400>One of Doom Flower Pot's greatest secrets is what he is made of. What kind of flower pot could survive an explosion intact? "I would not say completely intact," he says with a smile. "A special flexible material and a heat-resistant coating work pretty well, do they not?"</color>
1454.info:
Sacrifices its health to prevent Doom craters, helps the earth recover, and benefits from that recovery.

<color=#3D1400>Traits: </color><color=red>Short, Carrier, Can be planted on bare ground</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Can lose 75 Toughness, then lose HP equal to 20% of its Toughness, to prevent a crater from forming on its tile.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>While present, reduces crater repair time to 90 seconds. During repairs, restores HP equal to 2% of Toughness each second to the Doom Flower Pot with the lowest HP in that lane.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Flower Pot (base) + Doom-shroom</color>

1455.name: Doom Umbrella Leaf
1455.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Outside her regular job, Doom Umbrella Leaf also sells noise-canceling earplugs. There was never much demand for them, but thanks to her tireless efforts, sales now increase every day.</color>
1455.info:
Spreads its Irradiated canopy to protect plants and retaliates by launching airburst projectiles at zombies.

<color=#3D1400>Toughness: </color><color=red>1000</color>
<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>80</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>When it deflects a Bungee Zombie or projectile, or triggers umbrella knockback, launches one projectile. 1-second cooldown.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>On impact, the projectile deals damage in a 1.5-tile radius and ignores zombie position. If launched into the air, it splits into one projectile for every Irradiated zombie in its lane.</color>
<color=#3D1400>3. Umbrella Knockback: </color><color=red>Deals no damage and inflicts Irradiated on the target.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Umbrella Leaf + Doom-shroom</color>

1456.name: Sea Chomper
1456.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Sea Chomper ranks far above any so-called sea shark or sea whale in the food chain. That is exactly why Sea-shroom is not on his menu. A top predator like him does not eat vegetables.</color>
1456.info:
Grows while digesting, increasing its swallowing ability with each growth stage.

<color=#3D1400>Digest Time: </color><color=red>40s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Traits: </color><color=red>Aquatic, Short before its second growth</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Grows once after finishing digestion, up to 3 times. Each growth reduces Digest Time by 10 seconds and extends forward targeting range by 0.37 tiles. After growing 3 times, it can devour Giant zombies.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Sea-shroom (base) + Chomper</color>

1457.name: Snow Starfruit
1457.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Making many stars orbit around you on different paths does not sound like an easy magic trick. As its inventor, Snow Starfruit merely says, "It is nothing difficult for a five-star magician."</color>
1457.info:
Fires frozen stars that spiral outward around it.

<color=#3D1400>Targeting Range: </color><color=red>All ground positions</color>
<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>20 x 5 / 1.5s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Projectiles inflict Chill and add 10 Cryo points on hit. Deals 4x damage to Frozen zombies.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Starfruit + Ice-shroom</color>

1458.name: Chomper Fume-shroom
1458.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Chomper Fume-shroom has two mouths. The one that looks like a trash can is for eating. The one that sprays spores is for driving away anyone who mistakes him for a trash can.</color>
1458.info:
Devours nearby zombies and sprays stronger fumes while digesting.

<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>20 / 1.5s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Digest Time: </color><color=red>40s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>While digesting, deals double damage and knocks zombies back.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Fume-shroom + Chomper</color>

1459.name: Little Chomper-shroom
1459.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Little Chomper-shrooms come from the jungle. They are fierce, irritable, and have no interest in savoring plant life or enjoying the satisfaction of digestion. All they know is biting and moving forward. Then again, we are not Little Chomper-shrooms. Perhaps biting is how they have fun.</color>
1459.info:
A small ambush predator that charges forward, expending itself as it devours prey along the way.

<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>200</color>
<color=#3D1400>Traits: </color><color=red>Short, Stackable</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Immune to Freeze and crushing. When a zombie is within 1 tile ahead, leaves its tile to attack and becomes immune to damage. Advances about 0.4 tiles at a time. Devours an Imp zombie or a zombie below one-third HP in a small area; otherwise, deals damage.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Puff-shroom (base) + Chomper</color>

1460.name: Sea-shroom Flower Pot
1460.introduce: <color=#3D1400>"If I stay somewhere this damp every day, sooner or later I will grow mold and mushrooms!" Sea-shroom Flower Pot often complains as she feels the humid air, despite being a mushroom herself.</color>
1460.info:
Draws water from nearby sources to invigorate aquatic fusions growing on land.

<color=#3D1400>Traits: </color><color=red>Short, Carrier, Can be planted on bare ground</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>If a water tile is present within a 3 x 3 area, enters a Moist state. Grants land-based aquatic fusion plants in that area 50% Speed, or 25% for Ultimate plants. This bonus does not stack.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Flower Pot (base) + Sea-shroom</color>

1461.name: Garlic Starfruit
1461.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Garlic Starfruit does only three things each day: stays up late gaming, bathes in garlic juice, and replaces every meal with triple-sugar garlic milk tea. His neighbors gave up trying to fix his sleep schedule long ago, and almost no one wants to talk to someone who smells that strongly of garlic. He is happy, though, and that is enough for him.</color>
1461.info:
A garlic-flavored Starfruit.

<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>30 x 5 / 1.5s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Projectiles gain bonus damage equal to 5 times the target's Garlic points. Inflicts 1 Garlic point after dealing damage.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Starfruit + Garlic</color>

5003.name: Ultimate Greedy Boxgrass
5003.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Ultimate Greedy Boxgrass believes a mysterious treasure box from the deepest vault of Atlantis changed his plant life forever. The box fits him perfectly, summons zombies buried beneath Atlantis, stores extra hearts and vines, and, most importantly, keeps the seawater inside from ever spoiling. With it, Ultimate Greedy Boxgrass can finally venture onto the land he has always admired.</color>
5003.info:
Summons a disorderly mob on land, expanding the coverage of allied full-field attacks.
<color=blue>Ultimate Greedy Kelp Subspecies</color>

<color=#3D1400>Usage Conditions: </color><color=red>Purchase its recipe in Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=#3D1400>Conversion Recipe: </color><color=red>Surprise Gift Box <-> Zombie Mystery Box</color>
<color=#3D1400>Damage: </color><color=red>40 x 3 / 5s</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>Does not block zombies.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>While present, projectiles fired by newly generated Kelp Sprouts become Greedy Kelp projectiles.</color>
<color=#3D1400>3. </color><color=red>Before attacking each round, spawns a Golden Matryoshka Zombie. Defeating it within 10 seconds releases 3 Greedy Kelp projectiles.</color>

5004.name: Ultimate Little Pine Furnace
5004.introduce: <color=#3D1400>The entrance to the ice sculpture exhibition always displayed a sign reading, "No zombies allowed." After Ultimate Little Pine Furnace attended once, every later sign read, "No zombies or Ultimate Little Pine Furnaces allowed."</color>
5004.info:
Rapidly clears cold restraints from nearby plants, bringing healing and the crisp vitality of the Snowfield.

<color=#3D1400>Usage Conditions: </color><color=red>Purchase its recipe in Odyssey Mode</color>
<color=#3D1400>Fusion Recipe: </color><color=red>Super Little Pine Furnace + Snowthorn Aloe</color>
<color=#3D1400>Protection Range: </color><color=red>3 x 3</color>
<color=#3D1400>Trait: </color><color=red>Flying</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: 1. </color><color=red>When planted or moved, turns into a dropped card if its protection range overlaps that of another Ultimate Little Pine Furnace.</color>
<color=#3D1400>2. </color><color=red>Protected plants have Freeze duration reduced by 75%. Clearing an Icebound state always counts as being cleared by the plant side.</color>
<color=#3D1400>3. Essence Reserve: </color><color=red>Stores 1 Essence every 15 seconds and stores 1 when affected by Ice-shroom. Can store up to 3.</color>
<color=#3D1400>4. Essence Deployment: </color><color=red>Automatically deploys 1 Essence every 3 seconds. It also deploys 1 if a new Essence would be stored while the reserve is full, or if any protected plant is Frozen or Icebound, below one-third HP, or has Curse stacks greater than two-thirds of its HP.</color>
<color=#3D1400>5. When Essence is deployed in the protection range: </color><color=red>Immediately clears Freeze or Icebound from one plant, deals 500 damage to Ice Blocks, and grants 10 Charge stacks to Snow plants. When the Essence lands in the protection range, it restores 100 HP to all plants and grants 100 Shield to Snow plants.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Modifier 1: </color><color=red>Resolute Glow: Essence increases a plant's Toughness by 0.2% of its base value for the current round.</color>
<color=#3D1400>Modifier 2: </color><color=red>Surging Vitality: Essence grants twice the HP and Shield, clears Freeze or Icebound from up to 3 plants, and is stored automatically twice as fast.</color>

91.name: Pole Vaulting Football Zombie
91.introduce: <color=#3D1400>No one knows why Pole Vaulting Football Zombie brought a pole to a football game. According to him, it was because he wanted to vault out of the way of a horse wearing a jersey.</color>
91.info:
A football player who can pole vault.

<color=#3D1400>Toughness: </color><color=red>720 + 1400 (Type I)</color>
<color=#3D1400>Speed: </color><color=red>Above Average</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Vaults over the first plant it encounters, unless blocked by a Tall plant, then loses its pole.</color>

133.name: Cat-Squash Zombie
133.introduce: <color=#3D1400>Plant Zombies and their matching plants often have a strained relationship, but Cat-Squash Zombie and Cat-Squash get along very well. They often chat, sing, and shop for new outfits together. Sometimes she even helps Cat-Squash search the lawn for Endoflame Lotuses.</color>
133.info:
Summons Squash-type zombies based on how many plants it crushes.

<color=#3D1400>Toughness: </color><color=red>1500</color>
<color=#3D1400>Speed: </color><color=red>Fast</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>On contact with a plant, its head separates from its body and crushes all non-flying plants on one tile. It then spawns the same number of Squash Zombies on that tile, up to 3. If it crushed at least 3 plants, it also spawns 1 Spicy Squash Zombie. If it crushed no plants, it revives at full HP.</color>

261.name: <BOSS>Jackson Worldwide
261.introduce: <color=#3D1400>This is the final stop of a world tour and the last song of a stage legend. Fans from around the world have gathered for one final frenzy. The music and dance begin again and again because no one wants the show to end. Smoke rises from the stage to hide the reluctant looks in their eyes.</color>
261.info:
Presents a tour that never lowers its curtain on a flawless stage.

<color=#3D1400>Toughness: </color><color=red>90000</color>
<color=#3D1400>Special: </color><color=red>Immune to Chill, Freeze, immobilization, Enflamed, Garlic Poison, and tire punctures. When Chill or severe Poison would be applied, it instead takes 0.01% of its HP as damage. When Enflamed would be applied, it instead takes 0.04% of its HP as damage. Instantly defeats plants and hypnotized zombies, while dealing continuous damage to Spikeweed-type plants. Moves back and forth across the right half of the lawn, changes lanes every 5 seconds, and summons 4 General Michael Zombies and 4 white Pole Vaulting Dancing Zombies about every 10 seconds.</color>
